hints.en: Ask what she wants you to do.
Say you need her to send you her address.
hints.es: Necesito que me mandes tu dirección.

hints.en: Say everyone has to be at her place before Jorge arrives.
hints.es: Antes de que llegue Jorge, todos tienen que estar en tu casa.

hints.en: Say you hope he likes the surprise.
hints.es: Ojalá que le guste la sorpresa.

hints.en: Ask what his granddaughter likes to do.
hints.es: ¿Qué le gusta hacer a su nieta?

hints.en: Say it's important for her to go to the Art Institute and to try the food in Pilsen.
hints.es: Es importante que vaya al Instituto de Arte y que pruebe la comida de Pilsen.

hints.en: Recommend that she take the train and bring a jacket.
hints.es: Le recomiendo que tome el tren y que lleve una chamarra.

hints.en: Tell him not to worry, and to tell her to call you if she needs anything.
hints.es: No se preocupe, don Alfonso. Dígale que me llame si necesita algo.
